title: A "Before due" escalation longer than the target time can be saved
label: BUG
date: TAVI 10 Nov 2026 (live, on screen) · Zoho: help article (live Zoho did not load on this network)
env: TAVI staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging, owner) · SLA "QA AO SL54iuqp (inactive)", QA AO Dept A · Zoho: help.zoho.com › Understanding and working with SLAs › Escalations

panels.caption: Respond within 1 hour (1); response escalation level 1: Before due by 2 hours (2), i.e. one hour before the ticket exists.
Save is accepted with no message; the SLA is created (3).
Zoho Desk help, Escalations: escalate when the time "is close to the due time"; before, on or after (2). A limit on the Before offset is not documented; not seen live.

rows: An escalation "close to the due time" falls inside the target, so a Before offset longer than the target should be refused with a message.
Before due by 2 hours is accepted although the target is 1 hour: the escalation would be due before the ticket is created.
Saved with no warning (the server accepts it too). Levels out of order are refused, so only this check is missing.
